# CHD-3.2 Part IV — per-sheet render and defect record
Sections 13–16, render ticket C05 (`t_2c0d4427`). Date of record: 9 Nov 2026. Sources: `build-spec/VOL-B` §6 and §8, `VOL-D` §2/§3/§4/§5/§6/§7, `INDEX.md` §2 and §5, the included review inputs under `evidence/r32-review/inputs/`. Generator: `chd32/scripts/gen_p4_lib.py` + `p4_s13.py`, `p4_s14.py`, `p4_s15.py`, `p4_s16.py`. Every sheet links `chd32.css` and nothing else.

## Fit and mechanical check
| Sheet | Section | Fit free above footer | check.py | Pages | |---|---|---|---|---| | chd32-13-1-gates | 13 / 1 of 4 | 4.3 mm | ok (A4, 2 colours, allowed fonts) | 1 | | chd32-13-2 | 13 / 2 of 4 | 6.8 mm | ok | 1 | | chd32-13-3 | 13 / 3 of 4 | 4.0 mm | ok | 1 | | chd32-13-4 | 13 / 4 of 4 | 4.8 mm | ok | 1 | | chd32-14-1 | 14 / 1 of 3 | 5.4 mm | ok | 1 | | chd32-14-2 | 14 / 2 of 3 | 7.9 mm | ok | 1 | | chd32-14-3 | 14 / 3 of 3 | 9.3 mm | ok | 1 | | chd32-15-1 | 15 / 1 of 3 | 6.5 mm | ok | 1 | | chd32-15-2 | 15 / 2 of 3 | 4.8 mm | ok | 1 | | chd32-15-3 | 15 / 3 of 3 | 6.5 mm | ok | 1 | | chd32-16-1 | 16 / 1 of 5 | 5.5 mm | ok | 1 | | chd32-16-2 | 16 / 2 of 5 | 5.7 mm | ok | 1 | | chd32-16-3 | 16 / 3 of 5 | 8.0 mm | ok | 1 | | chd32-16-4 | 16 / 4 of 5 | 5.1 mm | ok | 1 | | chd32-16-5 | 16 / 5 of 5 | 7.2 mm | ok | 1 |
All fifteen sheets are single-page; no continuation sheet was needed inside a file. Multi-page measurement is therefore not applicable, and the footer band (770 pt) was not approached: every sheet reports free space above the footer rule inside the 4–10 mm band.

## Visual defects found on tiles and their fix
1. **Figure 13.2-1 (sheet 13-2).** The placard `3 TOOL CALL` was drawn at x = 123, inside the CHD SERVICE TOOL box (94–128), colliding with the box title; arrow 3 also began inside that box (x = 111.4). The bottom callout “NO STORE CALLS A GATEWAY…” sat on the lower edge of the DuckBrain box. *Fix:* arrow 3 redrawn agent sessions → service tool with a bare number `3` in the corridor (128–136); the “tool call” wording moved to numbered step 3 beneath the figure; the redundant bottom callout deleted. 2. **Figure 13.3-1 (sheet 13-3).** The label `3 BACKGROUND SYNC: EVENTUAL (last_synced_rev/ts)` measured ≈ 47 mm at `lbl-s` and overran the 47.2 mm corridor, touching both box edges; `5 COMPLETION REPORT: IMMEDIATE PATH ONLY` collided vertically with label 4; the SOLID/DASHED legend line ran through the VP + DELIVERY box. *Fix:* label 3 shortened to `3 BACKGROUND SYNC: EVENTUAL`; label 5 shortened to `5 REPORT: IMMEDIATE ONLY` and moved to the left of its arrow (x = 20, y = 54.6); the VP + DELIVERY box shortened to 7 mm; legend moved to y = 65.8 inside the panel. 3. **Figure 13.4-1 (sheet 13-4).** Inspected on tiles: no defect. The three arrows in the bridge↔inbox corridor occupy separate lanes (y = 9, 14, 19) with labels above each; arrow 2 and arrow 6 terminate at the inbox edge, arrow 4 terminates at the bridge edge; the dashed `3 OUT-ALT` runs bridge → topic. The ACK returns into the inbox and no arrow is reversed. 4. **Figure 14.1-1 (sheet 14-1).** Panel C right-aligned guarantee labels ended exactly on the panel border (x = 178). *Fix:* right edge pulled to 175.6, leaving 2.4 mm to the dashed border. 5. **Figure 14.2-1 (sheet 14-2).** Step 6's label sat 1.4 mm above its shaft (borderline on a 300 dpi tile) and step 9 was drawn ledger → harness, the reverse of an operator release. *Fix:* step 6 label raised to 2.0 mm clearance; step 9 redrawn as operator → capacity ledger from the right margin with the placard `9 OPERATOR`; the release rule is explained in numbered step 9 beneath the figure. 6. **Figure 15.2-1 (sheet 15-3).** The 100-index bar's top coincided with the upper band line, which reads as a value sitting on its own line. *Fix:* band widened to 19.4 / 22.6 so every measured bar top sits inside it with clearance. 7. **Head, tab and table ids inherited from the reclaimed attempt.** `chd32-13-1-gates.html` carried a non-conforming head (`CHD3.2A-04-BLOCK IV-(13-1)`), tab `OPS`, and table ids `13.1-1`/`13.1-2` that disagreed with `BOOK-chd32.yaml` (13.1-1 is the data-class table). *Fix:* the sheet is regenerated by `p4_s13.py` with the book head, tab `DEP`, readiness gates as TABLE 13.1-2, dependency failure as TABLE 13.1-3, and the data-class table as TABLE 13.1-1 printed first.

## Content-level checks performed
- Two storage topologies drawn as two drawings: FIGURE 13.2-1 (T-A, central-only, three data classes, consistency and authority annotated) and FIGURE 13.3-1 (T-B, local/federated project memory, solid = immediate, dashed = eventual, completion report on the immediate path only). No merged single-topology drawing exists in Part IV. - Crier bridge: FIGURE 13.4-1 draws outbound default (inbox), outbound alternative (topic), inbound lease/data, and the return ACK as four separately labelled arrows, plus the peer → local-policy mapping; the CAUTION states that connectivity confers no VP status and a `as: vp` claim is refused. - Failure matrix: FIGURE 14.1-1 draws normal, retry and restart as three separate panels; TABLE 14.1-1 registers all nine crash windows W1–W9 with durable state, the settling read, the action and the unknown-outcome branch; FIGURE 14.2-1 and TABLE 14.2-1 place stop confirmation before slot release (R31-006). - Metric readout: FIGURE 15.1-1 names producer → collector → read interface, units, window and reset, and the alert path; TABLE 15.1-2 now binds source labels, send/attempt/run correlation, dedupe, retention, migration, restart reconstruction and query output to the `MetricCheckpoint` schema; TABLE 15.2-3 separates measured performance from semantic, authorization, recovery and owner acceptance; FIGURE 15.2-1 draws the cost band with the provisional ceiling in the dotted style. - Traceability: TABLE 16.2-1 (test families → requirements → decisions → findings) and TABLE 16.2-2 (operation → record → transition → test); TABLE 16.3-1 prints all 87 ids (F-001..F-019, R31-001..R31-030, D-001..D-038) split across sheets 16-3 and 16-4 with `UNITS x-y of 87` placards; TABLE 16.4-1 maps all 11 CHD-3.1 sheets plus its index.

## Placeholders and duplicate claims
- `grep -E 'TBD|TODO|lorem|\[[A-Z][A-Z ]+\]'` over the fifteen sheets: no hit. - `tcap` census: every table id is printed once, except TABLE 15.1-1 and TABLE 16.3-1, which are deliberately split across two sheets with continuation placards and the same id. - `chd32/scripts/p4_manifest_sync.py` resolves every registered Part IV figure and table id to an owning sheet that prints it: RESULT OK. - R32-024 static retention probe: `python3 chd32/scripts/verify_metric_retention.py` executes measure → checkpoint/compact → collector restart → reconstruct and reports lifetime total 3 before/after, rolling-window expiry PASS, dedupe replay stability PASS, uncertain capacity visible PASS, and `capacity_label_source=attempt/run`. This is a fixture probe, not live deployment evidence.

## Known provisional item
- Leaf numbers 41–55 are the Part IV block. Parts I–III were rendering concurrently, so the continuous leaf counter is provisional until the merge ticket verifies the whole set; section folios (`SECTION n . SHEET i OF n`) are section-relative and therefore stable.
